# Jump Nav

In-page links to sections, where focus has to actually land on the target.

In `library/components/jump-nav/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

## ARIA

- **the nav** — `aria-label`
- **the current link** — `aria-current`
- **each target** — `tabindex=-1`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — after the jump the next stop is inside the target — if it took focus

**States:** current

## Goes wrong when

- no tabindex=-1 on the target, so the page scrolls and the next Tab starts from the top
- tabindex=0 on the target, which buys a Tab stop on every heading in the document
- scroll-margin-top of 0, which parks the heading under the sticky header (SC 2.4.11)
- two nav landmarks with no aria-label, indistinguishable in a landmark menu
- the active section written to a live region per scroll event — throttle it

**API:** `AC.createJumpNav(root, options) -> { links, targets, current, destroy }`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 2.4.1 2.4.3 2.4.7 2.4.11 2.5.8 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/landmarks/HTML/nav.html) · see also `skip-link`, `tabs`, `prose-surface`
